question: Should OpenClaw ship this Discord-specific subagent progress feature and permanently support its new configuration, requester message metadata, and channel lifecycle cleanup contract?
rationale: This is a new configurable capability and shared compatibility surface, so implementation correctness cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own the contract long term.

options.title: Sponsor, format, and prove
options.body: Accept the opt-in Discord feature and shared seam, fix formatting, and require exact-head visible behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the shared contract
options.body: Request a redesign using a smaller existing hook or metadata seam before accepting the feature.

options.title: Defer Discord-only progress
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers prefer a broader cross-channel subagent liveness design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor, format, and prove
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in Discord feature and shared seam, fix formatting, and require exact-head visible behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent merged work owns the Discord hook, plugin-boundary, and delivery-context seams most directly expanded by this PR.
